This guide provides clear, professional wording for document the failure to meet safety standards in an industrial safety audit.

### Step 1: Start with the inspection records.
Begin by formally documenting the site inspection findings as the foundational evidence for the audit report.

### Step 2: Check item by item according to the audit scoring standards.
Verify and score each item against the criteria established in the audit scoring standards.

### Step 3: Evaluate the completed standards and procedures for multiple enterprises.
Assess the various enterprises based on their compliance with the completed standards and procedures.

### Step 4: Summarize the inspection records according to the detected problems.
